notes.title: Drop Pockets 0.77.23
notes.content: [h3]Space ball overhaul[/h3][p]In an effort to make getting new balls more exciting, and building your stash more interesting, most space balls have been given new properties.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mercury: +50 points if mercury is the first ball scored[/p][/*][*][p]Venus: +1 hot stack at the start of every round[/p][/*][*][p]Earth: Also scores as a food ball[/p][/*][*][p]Saturn: +2 points for every filled additional rack slot, removed large[/p][/*][*][p]Uranus: Changes 1 random ball to frozen at the start of every round[/p][/*][*][p]Neptune: Added large[/p][/*][*][p]Pluto: +30 points during break phase[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Cues can now be swapped using the 1 and 2 keys[/p][p]Chalks can now be swapped using the 3 and 4 keys[/p][p]Added a clickable pause button[/p][p]The ball info menu has been changed to have the same information buttons found in other menus[/p][p][/p]
